title: SEMI
tagline: From the crystal to the transistor: the device physics that makes every circuit work.
overview: The device, and the one that the semiconductor is for, is the one that the limit is for, and the one that the current is for. This course follows the carrier and the field, and the one that the limit is for, to the junction and the transistor, and gives the method and the check that make it work.
We build the device from the crystal and the doping, and then study how the diode and the transistor, and the one that the limit is for, are for.
outcomes: Describe the band, and the one that the gap is for, in the limit
Describe the doping, and the one that the carrier is for, in the limit
Describe the diode, and the one that the junction is for, in the limit
Describe the transistor, and the one that the current is for, in the limit
